answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can score every identity with SybilRank: trust flows as a short seeded random walk from a few vetted agents across the attestation graph. Honest agents mix fast, so trust reaches each of them like water reaching every tree in an orchard. A sybil ring, however many identities it spawns, links to that honest region only through scarce attack edges real agents rarely grant, so almost no trust crosses, and its seats stay parched as a lone juniper, never the oasis the honest cluster shares. Ignore the low-trust tail and clones earn no standing.
